output.reason: [ev-030a6d8de1b4] shows the removed option configured three ways: a YAML static file (providers.http.tls.caOptional), a TOML static file ([providers.http.tls] caOptional) and the CLI flag --providers.http.tls.caOptional. The proposed exposure only checks the CLI flag, so it misses environments that set the option in a static configuration file. No static input shown here reliably locates that file, so I kept the CLI-flag check and added an undecidable operand for file-based configuration.

correction.statement: The HTTP provider tls.caOptional static option was removed in Traefik v3.0.0. Exposed are environments that set it with the CLI flag --providers.http.tls.caOptional or in a YAML/TOML static configuration file (providers.http.tls.caOptional).

of.needed: whether the Traefik static configuration file (YAML or TOML) sets providers.http.tls.caOptional
